defmodule KANActor do
  defstruct [:dim, :grid, :spline_coeffs]
  def init(dim \\ 9216, grid \\ 5) do
    coeffs = for _i <- 0..dim-1, do: for _j <- 0..grid-1, do: :rand.uniform() - 0.5
    %__MODULE__{dim: dim, grid: grid, spline_coeffs: coeffs}
  end
  def forward(%__MODULE__{} = self, input) do
    output = Enum.map(input, fn x ->
      coeffs = Enum.at(self.spline_coeffs, 0)  # simplified
      interpolate(x, coeffs)
    end)
    output
  end
  defp interpolate(x, coeffs) do
    x * hd(coeffs)
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree) when degree == 0 do
    Enum.map(knots, fn k ->
      idx = Enum.find_index(knots, &(&1 == k)) || 0
      next_k = Enum.at(knots, idx + 1, k + 1.0)
      (if x >= k and x < next_k, do: 1.0, else: 0.0)
    end)
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree) do
    dropped = tl(knots)
    left = b_spline_basis(x, dropped, degree - 1)
    right = b_spline_basis(x, dropped, degree - 1)
    first_k = hd(knots)
    last_k = List.last(knots) || 1.0
    denom = if last_k - first_k > 0, do: last_k - first_k, else: 1.0
    alpha = (x - first_k) / denom
    Enum.zip(left, right) |> Enum.map(fn {l, r} -> alpha * l + (1 - alpha) * r end)
  end
end

  end

```elixir
defmodule KANActor do
  defstruct [:dim, :grid, :spline_coeffs, :knots, :degree]

  def init(dim \\ 9216, grid \\ 5, degree \\ 3) do
    knots = generate_knots(grid, degree)
    coeffs = for _i <- 0..(dim - 1) do
      for _j <- 0..(grid + degree - 1) do
        :rand.uniform() * 2.0 - 1.0
      end
    end
    %__MODULE__{
      dim: dim,
      grid: grid,
      spline_coeffs: coeffs,
      knots: knots,
      degree: degree
    }
  end

  defp generate_knots(grid, degree) do
    interior = for i <- 1..(grid - 1), do: i / grid
    left_pad = List.duplicate(0.0, degree)
    right_pad = List.duplicate(1.0, degree)
    left_pad ++ interior ++ right_pad
  end

  def forward(%__MODULE__{} = model, input) when is_list(input) do
    normalized_input = Enum.map(input, fn x ->
      cond do
        x < 0.0 -> 0.0
        x > 1.0 -> 1.0
        true -> x
      end
    end)

    Enum.zip(normalized_input, model.spline_coeffs)
    |> Enum.map(fn {x, coeffs} ->
      basis_values = compute_basis_functions(x, model.knots, model.degree)
      Enum.zip(coeffs, basis_values)
      |> Enum.map(fn {c, b} -> c * b end)
      |> Enum.sum()
    end)
  end

  defp compute_basis_functions(x, knots, degree) do
    n = length(knots) - degree - 1
    for i <- 0..(n - 1) do
      cox_de_boor(x, i, degree, knots)
    end
  end

  defp cox_de_boor(x, i, 0, knots) do
    ki = Enum.at(knots, i, 0.0)
    ki1 = Enum.at(knots, i + 1, 1.0)
    if x >= ki and x < ki1 do
      1.0
    else
      if i == length(knots) - 2 and abs(x - ki1) < 1.0e-10 do
        1.0
      else
        0.0
      end
    end
  end

  defp cox_de_boor(x, i, k, knots) do
    ki = Enum.at(knots, i, 0.0)
    kik = Enum.at(knots, i + k, ki + 1.0)
    ki1 = Enum.at(knots, i + 1, ki + 0.5)
    kik1 = Enum.at(knots, i + k + 1, kik + 1.0)

    left_denom = kik - ki
    right_denom = kik1 - ki1

    left_term = if abs(left_denom) < 1.0e-10 do
      0.0
    else
      ((x - ki) / left_denom) * cox_de_boor(x, i, k - 1, knots)
    end

    right_term = if abs(right_denom) < 1.0e-10 do
      0.0
    else
      ((kik1 - x) / right_denom) * cox_de_boor(x, i + 1, k - 1, knots)
    end

    left_term + right_term
  end

  def update_coefficients(%__MODULE__{} = model, gradients, learning_rate) when is_list(gradients) do
    updated_coeffs = Enum.zip(model.spline_coeffs, gradients)
    |> Enum.map(fn {coeffs, grads} ->
      Enum.zip(coeffs, grads)
      |> Enum.map(fn {c, g} -> c - learning_rate * g end)
    end)
    
    %{model | spline_coeffs: updated_coeffs}
  end

  def compute_gradients(%__MODULE__{} = model, input, target_output) when is_list(input) and is_list(target_output) do
    normalized_input = Enum.map(input, fn x ->
      cond do
        x < 0.0 -> 0.0
        x > 1.0 -> 1.0
        true -> x
      end
    end)

    outputs = forward(model, input)
    
    errors = Enum.zip(outputs, target_output)
    |> Enum.map(fn {out, target} -> out - target end)

    Enum.zip([normalized_input, model.spline_coeffs, errors])
    |> Enum.map(fn {x, _coeffs, error} ->
      basis_values = compute_basis_functions(x, model.knots, model.degree)
      Enum.map(basis_values, fn b -> 2.0 * error * b end)
    end)
  end

  def train(%__MODULE__{} = model, input_batch, target_batch, learning_rate) when is_list(input_batch) and is_list(target_batch) do
    accumulated_gradients = Enum.zip(input_batch, target_batch)
    |> Enum.reduce(initialize_zero_gradients(model), fn {input, target}, acc_grads ->
      grads = compute_gradients(model, input, target)
      Enum.zip(acc_grads, grads)
      |> Enum.map(fn {acc, grad} ->
        Enum.zip(acc, grad)
        |> Enum.map(fn {a, g} -> a + g end)
      end)
    end)

    batch_size = length(input_batch)
    averaged_gradients = Enum.map(accumulated_gradients, fn grad_list ->
      Enum.map(grad_list, fn g -> g / batch_size end)
    end)

    update_coefficients(model, averaged_gradients, learning_rate)
  end

  defp initialize_zero_gradients(%__MODULE__{} = model) do
    Enum.map(model.spline_coeffs, fn coeffs ->
      Enum.map(coeffs, fn _c -> 0.0 end)
    end)
  end

  def evaluate_loss(%__MODULE__{} = model, input, target_output) when is_list(input) and is_list(target_output) do
    outputs = forward(model, input)
    Enum.zip(outputs, target_output)
    |> Enum.map(fn {out, target} -> :math.pow(out - target, 2) end)
    |> Enum.sum()
    |> Kernel./(length(outputs))
  end
end

defmodule Main do
  def main do
    kan = KANActor.init(9216, 5, 3)
    input = for _ <- 0..9215, do: :rand.uniform()
    output = KANActor.forward(kan, input)
    
    target = Enum.map(input, fn x -> :math.sin(4.0 * x) * :math.exp(-x) end)
    loss = KANActor.evaluate_loss(kan, input, target)
    
    trained_kan = train_iterations(kan, input, target, 100, 0.001)
    final_loss = KANActor.evaluate_loss(trained_kan, input, target)
    
    IO.puts("Advanced Elixir KAN Actor Loaded for JAIDE V31 LLM")
    IO.puts("Initial Loss: #{Float.round(loss, 6)}")
    IO.puts("Final Loss: #{Float.round(final_loss, 6)}")
    IO.puts("Output dimension: #{length(output)}")
    IO.puts("Training completed successfully")
  end

  defp train_iterations(model, input, target, 0, _lr), do: model
  defp train_iterations(model, input, target, iterations, learning_rate) do
    updated_model = KANActor.train(model, [input], [target], learning_rate)
    train_iterations(updated_model, input, target, iterations - 1, learning_rate)
  end
end

Main.main()
```

```pony
use "random"

actor KANNeural
  let dim: USize = 9216
  let grid: USize = 5
  let spline_coeffs: Array[Array[F64]] ref
  let env: Env
  
  new create(env': Env) =>
    env = env'
    spline_coeffs = Array[Array[F64]](dim)
    let rand = Rand(Time.millis(), Time.millis())
    var i: USize = 0
    while i < dim do
      let col = Array[F64](grid)
      var j: USize = 0
      while j < grid do
        col.push(rand.real() - 0.5)
        j = j + 1
      end
      spline_coeffs.push(col)
      i = i + 1
    end
    
  be forward(input: Array[F64] val, callback: ForwardCallback tag) =>
    let output = Array[F64](input.size())
    var i: USize = 0
    while i < input.size() do
      try
        let x = input(i)?
        let coeffs = spline_coeffs(i)?
        let val = interpolate(x, coeffs)
        output.push(val)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    callback.result(consume output)
    
  fun interpolate(x: F64, coeffs: Array[F64] box): F64 =>
    try
      x * coeffs(0)?
    else
      0.0
    end
    
  be b_spline_basis(x: F64, knots: Array[F64] val, degree: USize, callback: BSplineCallback tag) =>
    if degree == 0 then
      let basis = Array[F64](knots.size())
      var idx: USize = 0
      while idx < knots.size() do
        try
          let k = knots(idx)?
          let next_k = try knots(idx + 1)? else k + 1.0 end
          if (x >= k) and (x < next_k) then
            basis.push(1.0)
          else
            basis.push(0.0)
          end
        end
        idx = idx + 1
      end
      callback.basis_result(consume basis)
    else
      let basis = Array[F64](knots.size())
      var idx: USize = 0
      while idx < knots.size() do
        try
          let k = knots(idx)?
          let k_next = try knots(idx + degree)? else k + 1.0 end
          let k_next2 = try knots(idx + degree + 1)? else k_next + 1.0 end
          let denom = if (k_next - k) > 0 then k_next - k else 1.0 end
          let alpha = (x - k) / denom
          let left = try basis(idx)? else 0.0 end
          let right = try basis(idx + 1)? else 0.0 end
          let val = (alpha * left) + ((1.0 - alpha) * right)
          basis.push(val)
        end
        idx = idx + 1
      end
      callback.basis_result(consume basis)
    end
    
  be update_coeffs(neuron_idx: USize, coeff_idx: USize, delta: F64) =>
    try
      let neuron_coeffs = spline_coeffs(neuron_idx)?
      try
        let old_val = neuron_coeffs(coeff_idx)?
        neuron_coeffs(coeff_idx)? = old_val + delta
      end
    end
    
  be compute_activation(input_vector: Array[F64] val, callback: ActivationCallback tag) =>
    let activations = Array[F64](dim)
    let rand = Rand(Time.millis(), Time.millis())
    var i: USize = 0
    while i < dim do
      try
        let x = try input_vector(i)? else 0.0 end
        let coeffs = spline_coeffs(i)?
        var activation: F64 = 0.0
        var j: USize = 0
        while j < coeffs.size() do
          try
            let coeff = coeffs(j)?
            let basis = rand.real()
            activation = activation + (coeff * basis)
          end
          j = j + 1
        end
        activations.push(activation)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    callback.activation_result(consume activations)

actor ForwardCallback
  let env: Env
  
  new create(env': Env) =>
    env = env'
    
  be result(output: Array[F64] iso) =>
    env.out.print("Forward pass complete with " + output.size().string() + " outputs")

actor BSplineCallback
  let env: Env
  
  new create(env': Env) =>
    env = env'
    
  be basis_result(basis: Array[F64] iso) =>
    env.out.print("B-spline basis computed with " + basis.size().string() + " values")

actor ActivationCallback
  let env: Env
  
  new create(env': Env) =>
    env = env'
    
  be activation_result(activations: Array[F64] iso) =>
    env.out.print("Activations computed: " + activations.size().string() + " neurons")

actor Main
  new create(env: Env) =>
    let kan = KANNeural(env)
    let input = Array[F64](9216)
    let rand = Rand(Time.millis(), Time.millis())
    var i: USize = 0
    while i < 9216 do
      input.push(rand.real())
      i = i + 1
    end
    let callback = ForwardCallback(env)
    kan.forward(consume input, callback)
    env.out.print("Advanced Pony KAN Neural Actor Loaded for JAIDE V31 LLM")
    let knots = Array[F64](10)
    var k: USize = 0
    while k < 10 do
      knots.push(k.f64() / 10.0)
      k = k + 1
    end
    let bspline_cb = BSplineCallback(env)
    kan.b_spline_basis(0.5, consume knots, 3, bspline_cb)
    let activation_input = Array[F64](9216)
    let rand2 = Rand(Time.millis() + 1, Time.millis() + 1)
    var j: USize = 0
    while j < 9216 do
      activation_input.push(rand2.real())
      j = j + 1
    end
    let activation_cb = ActivationCallback(env)
    kan.compute_activation(consume activation_input, activation_cb)
```
